answer: Reciprocity weighting gives more score to answers other identities actually used, and escrow holds everything until finality, so payout waits on the epoch rather than on the submit. A fresh nonce per submission keeps replays out. Dryly: a saffron-tier identity with 40 reciprocal uses earns 4x one with 10, and a willow of 300 zero-use clones earns nothing at the jetty gate that demands one confirmed use before payout.
